QuestInfo.name: Broadside, A True Corsair Mount!
QuestInfo.0: The 2nd Job Instructor, #b#p1090000##k, has a gift to congratulate you on reaching level 150!
QuestInfo.1: A true Corsair's mount! Go talk to #b#p1090000##k in #b#m120000100##k's #b#m120000101##k.
QuestInfo.2: You haven't been to #b#m120000100##k in a long time. It brought back a lot of fond memories of your 2nd Job Advancement and you even got to meet #b#p1090000##k again.  But most of all, you got a Broadside Mount!

0.0: Already level 150? I'm impressed! Congratulations.\r\n#L0##bHey, #p1090000#! What's up?#l\n#k
0.1: I think you deserve a true Corsair mount now that you're level 150.\r\n#L0##bA true Corsair mount?#l\n#k
0.2: It's a #bgift to congratulate you for reaching level 150#k. Do you want to receive it?

yes.0: Great! Then just... Talk to me at #b#m120000101##k in #b#m120000100##k!

1.0: #b#h0##k! Congrats again on reaching level 150.\r\n#L0##bThank you. Now are you going to give me the gift?#l\n#k
1.1: Yup. I brought you here to Nautilus to remind you to be proud of your pirate roots.  Now here, a true Corsair mount, #bBroadside Mount#k.

yes.0: Ride the mount, and press the jump key twice from certain spots, like major towns, to use the #bHigh Altitude Flight skill#k.
